detail.body: # [MoE] Apply router scores before W2 projection Supersedes #4095: same motivation, reworked so the combine of every dispatcher is one never-replayed remat region and the router scores are absorbed before W2. ## Motivation Current `RoutedExperts` applies router scores to each routed expert output after the W2 projection in `TokenDispatcher.combine`: ``` routed_output_RD = ( routed_output_RD.to(torch.float32) * metadata.topk_scores_experts_sorted_N.reshape(-1, 1) ).to(routed_output_RD.dtype) ``` This multiplication causes the post-W2 `routed_output_RD` to retain for backward. Because W2 is linear, the router score can be applied earlier to the SwiGLU activation, immediately before W2: ``` routed_output_RD = W2(h_RF) * routed_score_R # current impl = W2(h_RF * routed_score_R) # our proposal ``` See the diagram below: ### Expected memory gain in full model: Combine output: `T * D * 2 = 4096 * 7168 * 2 = 56.0 MiB` per layer, `* 58 layers = 3.17 GiB` W2 output: `(T * top_k) * D * 2 = 4096 * 8 * 7168 * 2 = 448.0 MiB` per layer, `* 58 layers = 25.4 GiB` Total per GPU: `25.4 + 3.17 = 28.6 GiB` ### Expected recomputation gain in FullAC None added: the w2 grouped GEMM still replays exactly once per MoE layer, and the combine is a never-replayed region whose body (score multiply, unpermute, combine communication) runs only on the original forward. Measured on the debug model under FullAC, the replay path also rebuilds fewer saves (15 -> 5 per forward at EP=1), because the absorbed combine is a pure reduction that saves fewer tensors. ## Implementation The dispatcher returns the per-row router scores in its dispatch metadata, `GroupedLinear.forward(..., routed_scores_R=...)` scales W2's input in float32 before the grouped GEMM, and combine reduces to a plain sum. Config: - `make_routed_experts_config(absorb_router_scores: bool | None = None)` forwards the flag to the standard `AllToAllTokenDispatcher.Config`. `None` (auto) resolves at build time in `RoutedExperts.__init__` to "absorb unless the experts carry an `output_postprocess`". - DeepEP/HybridEP stay opt-in: `TokenDispatcherTransform(dispatcher=..., kwargs={"absorb_router_scores": True})`; their fused combines apply scores themselves, so they default to `False`. - `swap_token_dispatcher` (quantization) carries the flag across dispatcher swaps. Dispatcher: - Standard path: the dispatch remat region exchanges the scores alongside the tokens (same all-to-all splits), gathers them expert-major with the same `permuted_indices`, and returns them as `routed_scores_R` in the metadata (`None` when not absorbing -- `torch_remat.region` supports `None` tuple leaves). TorchAO overrides the gather to zero-fill padded rows. - `combine` skips the score multiply when the scores were absorbed (`_score_and_scatter_add` takes `topk_scores_N: Tensor | None`). - DeepEP/HybridEP: `dispatch` takes the tracked scores out of the backend state and clears them, so the fused combine applies no score; the scores ride `EPDispatchMetadata.routed_scores_R`. W2: - `GroupedLinear.forward(..., routed_scores_R=None)` scales the input in float32 and casts back before the grouped GEMM; `GptOssGroupedLinear` scales its post-W2 bias rows the same way. - `RoutedExperts` rejects `output_postprocess` + absorption (post-W2 postprocess must see unscaled outputs) and resolves auto at build time. ## Remat The combine of every dispatcher is one never-replayed `.combine` region whose body reads the w2 output (score multiply where not absorbed, unpermute/scatter-add, combine communication). Consequences: - Nothing on the replay path reads the w2 or combine outputs, so no `recompute_needs_tensor` marker pins the w2 output anymore. The earlier design durably packed it on the remat tape (reported as SAVE_OUTPUT) and re-ran multiply + unpermute on replay; with absorbed scores the w2 output is now freed after the forward instead of being retained for backward (the scatter-add saves only indices). - With absorbed scores the combine is a pure reduction: the region saves only the permutation indices (plus the scores when not absorbing). - The standard backends' absorbed scores are an output of the saved dispatch region, so W2's bare input scaling marks them with `recompute_needs_tensor`; that marker is a no-op on the DeepEP/HybridEP paths and without an active checkpoint. - Dispatch keeps following the remat policy everywhere; only the combine is always saved. ## Measured memory gain Measured by adding: ``` print(remat.format_saved_tensors_report(loss)) ``` in `def _non_pp_forward_backward_microbatch` in `training_engine.py`. > Note (cc @tianyu-liu): consider making the saved-tensors report a torchtitan configuration > instead of a debug print. ### Local dispatcher `deepseek_v3_debugmodel` with `LocalTokenDispatcher`, FullAC (T=16384, top_k=3). Under full recompute nothing MoE-related stays resident, so the difference is what the replay path must rebuild: | | saved for backward | saves rebuilt on recompute | | --- | --- | --- | | baseline | 19.00 MiB resident | 15 | | absorb | 19.00 MiB resident | 5 | ### All2All dispatcher The config used for the FullAC A/B (the all-to-all dispatcher falls back to its local methods at EP=1, so the numbers match the local row above): ```py def _deepseek_v3_debugmodel_all2all_fullac( seq_len: int | None, absorb_router_scores: bool ) -> Trainer.Config: config = deepseek_v3_debugmodel(seq_len=seq_len, attn_backend="flex") config.activation_remat = FullActivationRematConfig() return apply_transforms( config, [ TokenDispatcherTransform( dispatcher=AllToAllTokenDispatcher, kwargs={"absorb_router_scores": absorb_router_scores}, ) ], ) def deepseek_v3_debugmodel_all2all_fullac_non_absorb( seq_len: int | None = DEFAULT_DEBUG_MODEL_SEQ_LEN, ) -> Trainer.Config: return _deepseek_v3_debugmodel_all2all_fullac( seq_len=seq_len, absorb_router_scores=False ) def deepseek_v3_debugmodel_all2all_fullac_absorb( seq_len: int | None = DEFAULT_DEBUG_MODEL_SEQ_LEN, ) -> Trainer.Config: return _deepseek_v3_debugmodel_all2all_fullac( seq_len=seq_len, absorb_router_scores=True ) ``` Baseline output (absorb only removes rebuilt saves here, same as local): ``` [rank0]:saved for backward: 19.00 MiB resident -- 6 region(s) 2.81 MiB, outside regions 16.19 MiB [rank0]: [rank0]:regions: [rank0]: 0 B layers.0 (0 storages) [rank0]: 576.01 KiB x5 layers.1-5 (4 storages each) [rank0]: + 15 saves rebuilt on recompute, not resident [rank0]: [rank0]:outside regions: 16.19 MiB in 9 storages [rank0]: 8.06 MiB FusedRmsNormBackward0 (x2) [rank0]: 8.00 MiB _DecoderOutputGradientBackPropBackward (x1) [rank0]: 128.00 KiB EmbeddingBackward0 (x1) [rank0]: 40 B MulBackward0 (x5) ``` Absorb output: ``` [rank0]:saved for backward: 19.00 MiB resident -- 6 region(s) 2.81 MiB, outside regions 16.19 MiB [rank0]: [rank0]:regions: [rank0]: 0 B layers.0 (0 storages) [rank0]: 576.01 KiB x5 layers.1-5 (4 storages each) [rank0]: + 5 saves rebuilt on recompute, not resident [rank0]: [rank0]:outside regions: 16.19 MiB in 9 storages [rank0]: 8.06 MiB FusedRmsNormBackward0 (x2) [rank0]: 8.00 MiB _DecoderOutputGradientBackPropBackward (x1) [rank0]: 128.00 KiB EmbeddingBackward0 (x1) [rank0]: 40 B MulBackward0 (x5) [rank0]: [rank0]:region detail: [rank0]:layers.1: 576.01 KiB resident in 4 storage(s) [rank0]:layers.1::routing_decision: 384.00 KiB [rank0]: 384.00 KiB output at idx 0 (16384, 3) int64 [rank0]:layers.1::feed_forward.router.aux_loss.aux_loss: 192.01 KiB [rank0]: 4 B saved.0 () float32 [rank0]: 4 B saved.1 () float32 [rank0]: 192.00 KiB output at idx 0 (16384, 3) float32 [rank0]: + 1 save rebuilt on recompute, not resident ``` At EP=2 with RegionAC save-all, the baseline combine region retains the same tensors as DeepEP (per MoE layer; the 24.00 MiB bf16 row is the w2 output): ``` [rank0]:layers.1::moe.routed_experts.token_dispatcher.combine: 24.99 MiB [rank0]: 433.09 KiB saved.0 (55436,) int64 [rank0]: 192.00 KiB saved.1 (49152, 1) float32 [rank0]: 24.00 MiB saved.2 (49152, 256) bfloat16 [rank0]: 384.00 KiB saved.3 (49152, 256) int64 ``` With absorbed scores the combine retains only the permutation indices, as measured for DeepEP below. ### DeepEP dispatcher `deepseek_v3_debugmodel_deepep` (T=16384, top_k=3, EP=2, RegionAC save-all), `ep_communication.combine` region per MoE layer. Baseline: ``` [rank0]:saved for backward: 2.52 GiB resident -- 6 region(s) 2.50 GiB, outside regions 16.19 MiB [rank0]: [rank0]:regions: [rank0]: 379.38 MiB layers.0 (17 storages) [rank0]: 448.01 MiB layers.1 (21 storages) [rank0]: 429.44 MiB layers.2 (21 storages) [rank0]: 427.61 MiB layers.3 (21 storages) [rank0]: 441.39 MiB layers.4 (21 storages) [rank0]: 437.97 MiB layers.5 (21 storages) [rank0]: + 118 saves rebuilt on recompute, not resident [rank0]: [rank0]:layers.1::moe.routed_experts.token_dispatcher.ep_communication.combine: 27.99 MiB [rank0]: 109.81 KiB saved.0 (56225, 1) bfloat16 [rank0]: 27.45 MiB saved.1 (56225, 256) bfloat16 [rank0]: 439.26 KiB saved.2 (56225, 256) int64 ``` Absorb: ``` [rank0]:saved for backward: 2.43 GiB resident -- 6 region(s) 2.41 GiB, outside regions 16.19 MiB [rank0]: [rank0]:regions: [rank0]: 379.38 MiB layers.0 (17 storages) [rank0]: 414.24 MiB layers.1 (19 storages) [rank0]: 423.66 MiB layers.2 (19 storages) [rank0]: 418.56 MiB layers.3 (19 storages) [rank0]: 414.85 MiB layers.4 (19 storages) [rank0]: 419.60 MiB layers.5 (19 storages) [rank0]: + 118 saves rebuilt on recompute, not resident [rank0]: [rank0]:layers.1::moe.routed_experts.token_dispatcher.ep_communication.combine: 394.53 KiB [rank0]: 394.53 KiB saved.0 (50500, 256) int64 ``` Debug model A/B (`deepseek_v3_debugmodel_deepep`, T=16384, top_k=3, EP=2, RegionAC save-all): | | `ep_communication.combine` retained | | --- | --- | | baseline (score in combine) | 27.99 MiB = w2 output 27.45 MiB + scores 109.8 KiB + indices 439.3 KiB | | absorb | 394.5 KiB = indices only | Whole-run resident: 2.52 GiB -> 2.43 GiB. Nothing else in the report changes. 671B (T=4096, top_k=8, D=7168, 58 MoE layers, per GPU): w2 output `R*D*2` = 448 MiB/layer + scores 1 MiB/layer (absorption-attributable, 25.4 GiB total) + combine output `T*D*2` = 56 MiB/layer (independent marker cleanup, 3.17 GiB) = **28.6 GiB/GPU** avoided retention, with no recompute cost in exchange (w2 GEMM and combine are not replayed). ### HybridEP dispatcher Same mechanism as DeepEP: dispatch takes the per-row scores the HybridEP backend tracks and clears them from the dispatch state, so `hybridep.combine_tokens` skips its fused multiply and the scores ride `EPDispatchMetadata.routed_scores_R`. Opt-in like DeepEP. No separate A/B run: the HybridEP buffer is GB200/NVLink72-only. ## Tests and verifications - fp64 parity, standard dispatchers (`tests/unit_tests/gpu/distributed/test_standard_dispatchers_absorb_router_scores.py`, GPU, world 2): local, all-to-all at EP=1 (local fallback) and EP=2, TorchAO at EP=1 (padded permute, zero-sentinel scores) and EP=2. With rounding gone, the absorbed and post-combine paths compute the same function, so a dropped, doubled or misaligned score is an O(1) error; loss and every input/parameter gradient are asserted at the float32 scale W2's input scaling applies (rtol 1e-5). - fp64 parity, DeepEP (`tests/unit_tests/cpu/distributed/test_deepep_absorb_router_scores.py`, CPU, gloo, world 2): the deep_ep kernels are bf16-only, so the test stubs `ElasticBuffer` with a pure-PyTorch implementation (all_gather + local selection, deterministic layout, autograd-correct dispatch/combine backward) and runs the dispatcher, the torchtitan deepep wrapper, its custom ops and their autograd in float64. Same assertions; verified to fail on double-applied and on misaligned (rolled) scores. - Remat (CPU, `tests/unit_tests/cpu/models/common/test_token_dispatcher.py`): the combine body runs exactly once under every policy while the w2 projection's replay still follows the policy; with absorbed scores and w2 saved, the w2 output storage is freed after the forward; loss and grads match the un-checkpointed run bitwise. - Remat dumps for the local/all2all/deepep dispatchers: the A/B reports above. # Verification reports - [x] Local (CPU, real `torch_remat` + `RegionAC`): absorb vs post-combine scoring are numerically equivalent (rel diff ~0.25% = bf16 rounding); gradients flow to the scores in the absorbed path. - [x] Local fake-EP harness exercises the real AllToAll `dispatch`/`combine` regions: backward clean, `w2.grouped_mm` retains nothing with bf16 params, combine retains indices only, backward runs exactly one grouped GEMM (the w13 replay). - [x] GPU debugmodel A/B above: w2 output and combine output rows removed from `format_saved_tensors_report`. - [x] fp64 parity between the absorbed and post-combine versions: the standard dispatchers (GPU) and DeepEP through a pure-PyTorch `deep_ep` stub (CPU) agree in loss and all gradients at the float32 scale the absorb path applies (~1e-7 relative; asserted at rtol 1e-5). The DeepEP test fails on double-applied and on misaligned scores. - [x] remat dumps for local/all2all/deepep dispatchers. - [ ] Loss convergence on a representative dataset (e.g. C4) at equal steps, absorbed vs baseline. ## FusedMOE The fused MoE path is an optional, SM100+-only backend that only activates when explicitly selected, so on every path we actually run (all-to-all / DeepEP / HybridEP) this optimization applies unchanged — and even when selected, it replaces the module wholesale and is unaffected rather than broken.

+"""fp64 parity of absorbed router scores through the DeepEP dispatcher.
+
+The real deep_ep kernels are bf16-only, so this test replaces the
+ElasticBuffer with a pure-PyTorch stub (all_gather + local selection) and
+runs the dispatcher, the torchtitan deepep wrapper, its custom ops and their
+autograd on CPU in float64. With rounding gone, absorbing the router scores
+into W2's input and applying them after W2 compute the same function, so a
+dropped, doubled or misaligned score is an O(1) error.
+"""
+
+import importlib
+import sys
+import types
+from dataclasses import dataclass
+
+import torch
+import torch.distributed as dist
+import torch_remat as remat
+from torch.distributed.device_mesh import init_device_mesh
+from torch.testing._internal.distributed._tensor.common_dtensor import (
+    DTensorTestBase,
+    with_comms,
+)
+
+from torchtitan.distributed.spmd_types import set_current_spmd_mesh, set_spmd_meshes
+from torchtitan.models.base.module import Module, ModuleDict
+from torchtitan.models.common.activation import SwiGLU
+from torchtitan.models.common.linear import GroupedLinear
+from torchtitan.models.common.moe import RoutedExperts
+from torchtitan.models.common.moe.token_dispatcher import DeepEPTokenDispatcher
+
+_MODEL_DIM = 8
+_NUM_TOKENS = 64
+_TOP_K = 2
+
+
+# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
+# deep_ep kernel stub
+# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
+
+
+class _FakeEvent:
+    """No-op stand-in for deep_ep's async combine event."""
+
+    def current_stream_wait(self) -> None:
+        pass
+
+
+class _FakeHandle:
+    """Routing layout of one dispatch, computed identically on every rank.
+
+    ``per_rank_recv[r]`` is ``(src_rank_R, src_token_R)``: row i of rank r's
+    received tokens is token ``per_rank_recv[r][1][i]`` of rank
+    ``per_rank_recv[r][0][i]``.
+    """
+
+    def __init__(self, per_rank_recv, num_recv_tokens_per_expert_list, num_tokens):
+        self.per_rank_recv = per_rank_recv
+        self.num_recv_tokens_per_expert_list = num_recv_tokens_per_expert_list
+        self.num_tokens = num_tokens
+        self.num_sms = 0
+
+
+def _all_gather_rows(rows: torch.Tensor, group) -> list[torch.Tensor]:
+    """all_gather a tensor whose leading dimension varies per rank."""
+    num_ranks = dist.get_world_size(group)
+    count = torch.tensor([rows.shape[0]], device=rows.device)
+    counts = [torch.empty_like(count) for _ in range(num_ranks)]
+    dist.all_gather(counts, count, group=group)
+    max_rows = max(int(c.item()) for c in counts)
+    padded = rows.new_zeros(max_rows, *rows.shape[1:])
+    padded[: rows.shape[0]] = rows
+    gathered = [torch.empty_like(padded) for _ in range(num_ranks)]
+    dist.all_gather(gathered, padded, group=group)
+    return [g[: int(c.item())] for g, c in zip(gathered, counts)]
+
+
+class _FakeElasticBuffer:
+    """Pure-PyTorch stand-in for deep_ep.ElasticBuffer, compact layout only.
+
+    Dispatch gathers every rank's tokens and keeps the rows with at least one
+    local expert pick (deduplicated, one row per token). Combine sends rows
+    back to their owners, which sum the rows of each token. The layout is a
+    deterministic function of the gathered inputs, so all ranks agree on it
+    and repeated dispatches receive rows in the same order.
+    """
+
+    def __init__(
+        self,
+        group,
+        *,
+        num_bytes,
+        num_max_tokens_per_rank,
+        hidden,
+        num_topk,
+        use_fp8_dispatch=False,
+        deterministic=False,
+        explicitly_destroy=False,
+    ):
+        self.group = group
+        self.num_bytes = num_bytes
+        self.num_max_tokens_per_rank = num_max_tokens_per_rank
+        self.deterministic = deterministic
+
+    @staticmethod
+    def get_buffer_size_hint(
+        group, num_max_tokens_per_rank, hidden, *, num_topk, use_fp8_dispatch=False
+    ):
+        return 1
+
+    def get_theoretical_num_sms(self, num_experts, num_topk):
+        return 1
+
+    def dispatch(
+        self,
+        x,
+        *,
+        topk_idx=None,
+        topk_weights=None,
+        num_experts=None,
+        num_max_tokens_per_rank=None,
+        num_sms=0,
+        handle=None,
+        do_expand=False,
+        do_cpu_sync=True,
+    ):
+        if handle is not None:
+            return self._dispatch_from_handle(x, handle)
+        assert not do_expand, "the stub implements the compact layout only"
+        return self._dispatch_fresh(x, topk_idx, topk_weights, num_experts)
+
+    def _dispatch_fresh(self, x, topk_idx, topk_weights, num_experts):
+        num_ranks = dist.get_world_size(self.group)
+        rank = dist.get_rank(self.group)
+        num_local_experts = num_experts // num_ranks
+        xs = _all_gather_rows(x, self.group)
+        idxs = _all_gather_rows(topk_idx, self.group)
+        ws = _all_gather_rows(topk_weights, self.group)
+
+        per_rank_recv = []
+        recv_x, recv_idx, recv_scores = [], [], []
+        for r in range(num_ranks):
+            lo = r * num_local_experts
+            src_ranks, src_tokens = [], []
+            for s in range(num_ranks):
+                # -1 picks (no selection) and other ranks' experts fall outside
+                # [lo, lo + num_local_experts).
+                is_local = (idxs[s] >= lo) & (idxs[s] < lo + num_local_experts)
+                keep = is_local.any(dim=1)
+                src_ranks.append(
+                    torch.full((int(keep.sum()),), s, dtype=torch.long, device=x.device)
+                )
+                src_tokens.append(keep.nonzero(as_tuple=False).squeeze(-1))
+                if r == rank:
+                    recv_x.append(xs[s][keep])
+                    recv_idx.append(torch.where(is_local[keep], idxs[s][keep] - lo, -1))
+                    recv_scores.append(ws[s][keep])
+            per_rank_recv.append((torch.cat(src_ranks), torch.cat(src_tokens)))
+        recv_idx = torch.cat(recv_idx)
+        handle = _FakeHandle(
+            per_rank_recv=per_rank_recv,
+            num_recv_tokens_per_expert_list=torch.bincount(
+                recv_idx[recv_idx >= 0], minlength=num_local_experts
+            ).tolist(),
+            num_tokens=x.shape[0],
+        )
+        return (
+            torch.cat(recv_x),
+            recv_idx,
+            torch.cat(recv_scores),
+            handle,
+            _FakeEvent(),
+        )
+
+    def _dispatch_from_handle(self, grad_TD, handle):
+        # Combine backward: a received row's gradient is its owner token's row.
+        num_ranks = dist.get_world_size(self.group)
+        rank = dist.get_rank(self.group)
+        grads = _all_gather_rows(grad_TD, self.group)
+        src_rank_R, src_token_R = handle.per_rank_recv[rank]
+        grad_rows = grad_TD.new_zeros(src_rank_R.numel(), grad_TD.shape[1])
+        for s in range(num_ranks):
+            from_s = src_rank_R == s
+            if bool(from_s.any()):
+                grad_rows[from_s] = grads[s][src_token_R[from_s]]
+        empty = grad_rows.new_zeros(0)
+        return grad_rows, empty.long(), empty, handle, _FakeEvent()
+
+    def combine(self, x, *, handle, topk_weights=None, async_with_compute_stream=False):
+        # Forward combine and dispatch backward share this reduction: each
+        # owner token sums the rows routed to it across all ranks.
+        num_ranks = dist.get_world_size(self.group)
+        rank = dist.get_rank(self.group)
+        xs = _all_gather_rows(x, self.group)
+        ws = (
+            None if topk_weights is None else _all_gather_rows(topk_weights, self.group)
+        )
+        out = x.new_zeros(handle.num_tokens, x.shape[1])
+        out_weights = (
+            None
+            if ws is None
+            else topk_weights.new_zeros(handle.num_tokens, topk_weights.shape[1])
+        )
+        for r in range(num_ranks):
+            src_rank_R, src_token_R = handle.per_rank_recv[r]
+            mine = src_rank_R == rank
+            if bool(mine.any()):
+                out.index_add_(0, src_token_R[mine], xs[r][mine])
+                if out_weights is not None:
+                    out_weights.index_add_(0, src_token_R[mine], ws[r][mine])
+        return out, out_weights, _FakeEvent()
+
+
+def _import_wrapper_with_stub():
+    """Import the deepep wrapper against the stub when deep_ep is absent."""
+    try:
+        import deep_ep  # noqa: F401
+    except ImportError:
+        stub = types.ModuleType("deep_ep")
+        stub.ElasticBuffer = _FakeElasticBuffer
+        sys.modules["deep_ep"] = stub
+        injected = True
+    else:
+        injected = False
+    wrapper = importlib.import_module("torchtitan.distributed.deepep.deepep")
+    if injected:
+        # Sibling tests' importorskip("deep_ep") must still skip honestly.
+        del sys.modules["deep_ep"]
+    return wrapper
+
+
+_deepep_wrapper = _import_wrapper_with_stub()
+# The wrapper registers its op impls for the CUDA key only; the stub runs on
+# CPU, so point the same impls at the CPU key.
+_cpu_impl_library = torch.library.Library("deepep", "FRAGMENT")
+_cpu_impl_library.impl("dispatch", _deepep_wrapper._dispatch_op_impl, "CPU")
+_cpu_impl_library.impl("combine", _deepep_wrapper._combine_op_impl, "CPU")
+
+
+# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
+# fp64 parity test
+# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
+
+
+class _ExactGroupedLinear(GroupedLinear):
+    """GroupedLinear whose GEMM runs in the weight dtype.
+
+    ``torch._grouped_mm`` is bf16-only, so the fp64 test swaps in this
+    per-group matmul through the documented ``_grouped_mm`` override seam.
+    ``RoutedExperts.forward`` hands w13 a bf16 input; both parity paths see
+    the same bf16 rounding, so upcasting it keeps the comparison sharp.
+    """
+
+    @dataclass(kw_only=True, slots=True)
+    class Config(GroupedLinear.Config):
+        pass
+
+    def _grouped_mm(self, *, input_RI, weight_EOI, offsets_E):
+        input_RI = input_RI.to(weight_EOI.dtype)
+        starts = [0, *offsets_E[:-1].tolist()]
+        return torch.cat(
+            [
+                input_RI[start:end] @ weight_EOI[expert].transpose(-2, -1)
+                for expert, (start, end) in enumerate(zip(starts, offsets_E.tolist()))
+            ],
+            dim=0,
+        )
+
+
+class _DeepEPBlock(Module):
+    """One routed-experts block behind a DeepEP dispatcher."""
+
+    def __init__(self, num_experts: int, *, absorb_router_scores: bool):
+        super().__init__()
+        # RoutedExperts.forward runs after EP has selected this rank's local

+class _W2Region(Module):
+    """Stand-in for the w2 grouped projection: one policy-controlled region.
+
+    The matmul allocates a fresh output and, like a grouped GEMM, saves its
+    input and weight (not its output) for backward, so only the remat
+    machinery could retain the output. ``num_forwards`` counts region-body
+    executions, so a skipped replay does not count.
+    """
+
+    def __init__(self):
+        super().__init__()
+        self.weight = nn.Parameter(torch.randn(_MODEL_DIM, _MODEL_DIM))
+        self.num_forwards = 0
+
+    def forward(self, x_RD: torch.Tensor) -> torch.Tensor:
+        return remat.region(
+            self._project,
+            self.remat_region_name("grouped_mm"),
+            recompute=self.remat_should_recompute("grouped_mm"),
+        )(x_RD)
+
+    def _project(self, x_RD: torch.Tensor) -> torch.Tensor:
+        self.num_forwards += 1
+        return x_RD @ self.weight

+
+class _DispatcherBlock(Module):
+    """Routed-experts block: dispatch, one projection, combine.
+
+    The router scores depend on the gate, so a wrong score placement or a
+    misaligned combine changes the gradients, as in training.
+    """
+
+    def __init__(self, dispatcher_config: LocalTokenDispatcher.Config):
+        super().__init__()
+        self.token_dispatcher = dispatcher_config.build()
+        self.w2 = _W2Region()
+        self.gate = nn.Linear(_MODEL_DIM, _NUM_EXPERTS, bias=False)
+        self.num_experts = _NUM_EXPERTS
+        self.top_k = dispatcher_config.top_k
+
+    def forward(self, x_TD: torch.Tensor) -> torch.Tensor:
+        num_tokens = x_TD.shape[0]
+        token_ids_T1 = torch.arange(num_tokens, device=x_TD.device).unsqueeze(-1)
+        offsets_1K = torch.arange(self.top_k, device=x_TD.device).unsqueeze(0)
+        expert_ids_TK = (token_ids_T1 + offsets_1K) % self.num_experts
+        scores_TK = torch.sigmoid(self.gate(x_TD)).gather(1, expert_ids_TK)
+        num_tokens_per_expert_E = torch.bincount(
+            expert_ids_TK.flatten(), minlength=self.num_experts
